## What changed
- **`scripts/shiki_guardian.py`**
  - `_comment_source`: the `guardian_comment` marker must now be **line-initial** to count as approval. Negation/revocation detection (`_comment_negates_approval`) runs on any comment that *contains* the marker (moved out of the old "marker not in body" branch), recording a **soft blocker** — never a silent pass. New helpers `_marker_is_line_initial` / `_comment_negates_approval` + `COMMENT_NEGATION_MARKERS`.
  - `_valid_label_actor`: resolves the **latest** `labeled`/`unlabeled` transition for `policy.label` (by `created_at`, stable-tiebroken by input index) and accepts only when that latest transition is a `labeled` event by a configured Guardian.
- **`.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml`**: added `labeled`/`unlabeled` to `pull_request.types` (a label change re-runs the CCA→verdict on its own); pinned the `mergegate` job to **read-only** permissions; added `--paginate` to the 6 Guardian-evidence `gh api` calls so the latest transition / mid-run approval is never missed on page 2.
- **`scripts/validate_shiki.py`**: `WORKFLOW_CONTRACTS["shiki-cca-completion.yml"]` now pins `job_permissions.mergegate` (all-read) — removing the block fails the validator (verified by negative control).
- **Tests**: new `tests/test_guardian_evidence.py` (18 tests, run by the loop gate); added negation/revocation + latest-label-transition fixtures to `test_shiki_guardian_policy.sh`; added a full-gate exit-1 negated-marker fixture to `test_shiki_governance_evidence.sh`.

It is unrelated to this change and unfixable within my locks; it passes end-to-end in a checkout with no unregistered sibling worktrees.

## Pre-PR code review (for the PR body / ledger)
Adversarial reviewer ran on the Guardian gate. **Confirmed clean:** read-only mergegate perms are sufficient (no step writes to GitHub); no `labeled`/`unlabeled` self-trigger loop (nothing mutates PR labels); a negation soft-blocker cannot poison a valid current-head approval (demoted to warning). **Fixed (both in-locks, serving the "latest transition governs / revocation honoured" goal):** latest-label resolution now orders by `created_at` not concat position; added `--paginate` so a page-2 revocation/approval isn't truncated; and the negation soft-blocker is now gated on marker-presence (removes audit noise from unrelated cue-word comments). **Accepted limitations (not fixed, with reason):** the negation cue list is a denylist — a *configured Guardian* who starts a line with the exact approval phrase and then negates it with wording outside the cue set (e.g. "…NOT yet") is a bounded guardian footgun, not an external bypass; broadening the list risks false-negatives on legitimate approvals (e.g. "no longer blocked"). The line-initial rule is the primary defense and rejects all realistic negation phrasings.
